comments.author: @jguasch43
comments.text: This video is laughable. How can anyone trust what they hear and see, when very few of the photos were of Whittier. Certainly not any of the tunnel photos. Many of the town photos were of Ketchikan. There was also a beautiful winter scene taken in East Turkey and a favorite photo of Yosemite Falls! Don’t waste  your time. This goes for any of the Where on Earth Videos. I will never trust or watch another one.
